Smith]] |asst_coach2 = Eric Grabriel |asst_coach3 = [[Keith Gatlin]] |stadium = [[Millis Athletic Convocation Center]] |champion = |tourney= |tourney_result = }} {{2020–21 Big South men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 High Point Panthers men's basketball team''' represented [[High Point University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers, led by third-year head coach [[Tubby Smith]], played their home games at the [[Millis Athletic Convocation Center]] in [[High Point, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Big South Conference]]. This was the Panthers' final season at the Millis Center, with the new [[Qubein Center]] opening for [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the Panthers recorded 9–15 record, 6–11 in Big South play, to finish in eighth place. They defeated [[2020–21 USC Upstate Spartans men's basketball team|USC Upstate]] in the first round of the [[2021 Big South Conference men's basketball tournament|Big South tournament]]{{Cite news |last=McMahon |first=Kevin |date=February 27, 2021 |title=Wright's Double-Double Leads HPU To Big South First Round Win |url=https://highpointpanthers.com/news/2021/2/27/mens-basketball-wrights-double-double-leads-hpu-to-big-south-first-round-win.aspx |access-date=November 24, 2021 |work=High Point University Athletics |language=en}} before losing to [[2020–21 Winthrop Eagles men's basketball team|Winthrop]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite news |date=March 1, 2021 |title=#1 Winthrop Moves Past #8 High Point, 83-54 for trip to Semifinals |url=https://bigsouthsports.com/news/2021/3/1/mens-basketball-1-winthrop-moves-past-8-high-point-83-54-for-trip-to-semifinals.aspx |access-date=November 24, 2021 |work=Big South Conference |language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 High Point Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 9–23, 6–12 in Big South play, to finish in a tie for tenth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Big South Conference men's basketball tournament|Big South tournament]] to [[2019–20 USC Upstate Spartans men's basketball team|USC Upstate]].{{Cite web
